name: Thaumaturgical Rituals — 2 Intermediate — Ritual of Darkness

system.description: Devised by Carna to escape a dangerous situation roughly three centuries ago, this ritual blankets the caster's Haven in an impenetrable darkness that only the caster can see through. The caster smears soot from a coal fire on the windows; the casting takes a full hour. The darkness persists until sunlight touches it directly — which may mean it lasts indefinitely in an underground Haven. Carna is willing to teach this ritual to other Tremere, and a handful already know it.
system.source: Milwaukee by Night, Chapter Three: The Kindred (Carna's own creation)
